posts.title: AI would be net-positive for planet Earth
posts.description: Humans have been destroying the planet well before the age of Artificial Intelligence. posts.title: the need to be perfect continues to strangle my life
posts.description: I have always been a 'independent and perfectionist' as far as I can remember. As a kid I used to associate it as a mark of pride - of doing the things the right way all on my own. It's only when I reached high school, I got to know I use that as a shield to avoid any criticism and never reach out to others to avoid being seen as vulnerable.
